section_summary.extract_value: This introduction discusses breast size dissatisfaction in women and reviews existing measurement tools, particularly the Breast Size Rating Scale (BSRS) developed by Swami et al. (2015) for British women. The present study (Study X) aims to examine the psychometric properties of the BSRS in a sample of Brazilian women, assessing correlations between breast size dissatisfaction and variables including body appreciation, body dissatisfaction, and BMI, as well as test-retest reliability after 15 days.
